Remarks

Provides a unified interface for collision detection, overlap, intersection, and containment logic for various shape types. Handles event notification for collision events and manages parent relationships and collider state.

Property Value

BitFlag

ComputeCollision

Gets or sets whether this collider should compute collisions.

public bool ComputeCollision { get; set; }

Property Value

bool

Remarks

If false the collider still takes place in the collision system and other colliders can collide with it, but it will not report overlaps/collisions itself.

ComputeIntersections

Gets or sets whether this collider should compute intersection details (if false, only overlaps are reported).

public bool ComputeIntersections { get; set; }

Property Value

bool

Gets or sets whether this collider is enabled for collision detection.

ContainsShape(Circle)

Checks if this collider contains the given circle shape.

public bool ContainsShape(Circle shape)

Parameters

shape Circle

The circle shape to check.

Returns

bool

True if the circle shape is contained, otherwise false.

Remarks

The entire shape must be fully enclosed within this collider for the method to return true. Partial overlaps or edge contacts are not considered as containment.

Events

OnContactEnded

Occurs when a collision (intersection or overlap) with this collider ends.

AdvancedCollisionNotification must be enabled on the parent for this event to be invoked.

  • Action parameter: The Collider with which contact ended.
public event Action<Collider>? OnContactEnded

Event Type

Action<Collider>

OnIntersected

Occurs when this collider intersects with another collider.

AdvancedCollisionNotification must be enabled on the parent for this event to be invoked.

  • Action parameter: Collision information about the intersection.
public event Action<Collision>? OnIntersected

Event Type

Action<Collision>

OnOverlapped

Occurs when this collider overlaps with another collider.

AdvancedCollisionNotification must be enabled on the parent for this event to be invoked.
